summary.text: Ed Larvadain is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 26, representing Rapides, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2019 as the year elected.
The page lists Ed Larvadain with committee assignments including Civil Law and Procedure (Vice Chair).

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Ed Larvadain's occupation as Attorney.
It lists Ed Larvadain's education as B.A., Political Science, Southern University and A&M College, 1987 J.D., Southern University Law Center, 1992.
The House member page lists Ed Larvadain's committee assignments as Civil Law and Procedure (Vice Chair); House and Governmental Affairs; Labor and Industrial Relations.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus; Democratic Caucus; Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus.
